study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of brain function abnormalities in complex pathology needs the whole brain

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Functional Connectivity Integrative Normative Modelling (FUNCOIN), an integrative whole-brain normative model based on covariate-assisted principal regression.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we thus propose Functional Connectivity Integrative Normative Modelling (FUNCOIN) as a novel whole-brain approach to normative modelling of FC.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Resting-state fMRI functional connectivity matrices computed as Pearson correlations between ICA components.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Our measure of brain function is FC, determined in this case as the Pearson correlation matrix from all pairs of the parcellation components
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Results / Whole-brain normative modelling of FC

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates included age, sex, and the sex-age interaction in the normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We included sex, age, and sex-age interaction as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: media-1.pdf.md: Supplementary text / Assessing potential scanning site effects
